ui.settings.voice.label: Session voice
ui.settings.voice.description: Lets you talk to a conversation hands-free. Off by default. While it is off, nothing for voice runs: no microphone, no speech models and no background checks. Turning it on adds a voice button to the composer; turning it off stops voice at once and releases the microphone.
ui.settings.voice.engine.label: Voice engine
ui.settings.voice.engine.description: Where listening and speaking happen. Applies to session voice only.
ui.settings.voice.engine.local.label: Local
ui.settings.voice.engine.local.descripti: Speech models on this computer. Uses about 5 GB of memory while voice is on.
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.label: Bring your own key (ElevenLabs)
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.descriptio: Uses your own ElevenLabs account, so nothing loads on this computer. ElevenLabs charges your account for the speech.
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.missing: No ElevenLabs key yet. In Local Operator, run /login elevenlabs and paste your key.
ui.settings.voice.engine.radient.label: Radient cloud
ui.settings.voice.engine.radient.descrip: Speech billed with your Radient credit.
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.label: ElevenLabs API key
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.hint: Kept in Local Operator's own credential store, not in this app, and never shown again.
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.saved_unver: Key saved, but ElevenLabs could not check it, so it is unverified. Keys limited to speech often cannot be checked.
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.failed: The key could not be saved.
